name: GigaSpeech
description: A 10,000-hour, multi-domain English speech recognition corpus assembled from audiobooks, podcasts, and YouTube audio, with transcriptions and multiple data-quality subsets.
citation: Chen, G., Chai, S., Wang, G., et al. (2021). GigaSpeech: An Evolving, Multi-domain ASR Corpus with 10,000 Hours of Transcribed Audio. https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.06909
